_comment: Instance data for core/helpers/autonomous-mode.cjs: regex strings in the operator's own language that
ORDER an autonomous run (on_patterns) or end it (off_patterns). The built-ins are English ('autonomous',
'work the list alone', 'I'm away' / 'normal mode', 'stop autonomous'). Only the operator's NEWEST prompt
decides, so a later prompt without the word ends the mode anyway. Example for a German operator:
"\\bnicht mehr autonom\\b". Read by stoppen-gate (a closing decision is filed, not asked through the
question tool) and open-items-gate (the order is the go-ahead).
